tools.description: To resolve an employer slug (the segment after join.com/companies/) to its numeric company id and city ids before listing jobs, or to read the employer's benefits and offices.
Enrich up to ten companies in one call, billed 30 Firecrawl credits per matched company; unmatched records are free.
When you have a job id or last_id from jobs, or a pasted ad URL (join.com/companies/<slug>/<id_param> or join.com/jobs/<last_id>), and need the description, salary, hours, vacation or contract terms.

List every board posting of an employer found through search (pass its company.id) or from a pasted jobs.workable.com/company/ URL. Pass next_cursor back as cursor for the next page; use board_job for one posting's full text. For an employer's own careers page use employer_jobs.

Start here with an employer slug (or company_id from company) to enumerate its openings; pass next_page back as page. Use category_ids from categories or this function's aggregations, city_id from company offices or aggregations. There is no keyword search on JOIN.
Use when you have a domain or LinkedIn company URL and need the company behind it. For a company you can only name, search first.

List public jobs advertised on a YC company profile, including source salary text, location, role and requirements. Each record adds best-effort structured locations, a remote/hybrid/onsite flag and ISO country codes parsed from the location text, plus the source role slug, skills, posting age, apply link and batch. No application or contact actions.
Use to find executives and role holders at a company, or the marketing, brand and partnerships contacts a sponsorship conversation would go to.

Search public jobs across all YC companies. Title words (e.g. intern summer 2027, founding engineer) are matched against the job title in every job URL of YC's public jobs sitemap (never the company slug), newest first; role, type, remote_allowed / remote_only, country and location filters are applied while job pages are read, so a call keeps scanning until page_size records (default 10, max 50) are found or the per-call cap of 120 job pages / 30 s is reached (scan_limited true, partial page plus next_offset). Returns excluded counts per filter and candidates_scanned. A pasted /jobs/role/<role>[/<location>] or /jobs/location/<location> URL supplies role and location.

Match a known company using identifiers with the base product. Name matching is global and cannot be narrowed by country, so for non-US or ambiguous names also send the website domain as domain, or the LinkedIn company page URL as social_url.
List a channel's live streams, upcoming streams/premieres and stream replays, paged by continuation.
List the public playlists a channel shows, paged by continuation.
List a channel's Shorts, newest first, paged by continuation.
List a channel's uploads, newest first, paged by continuation.
Read a comment thread after video_comments.
List the videos in a public playlist, paged by continuation.
Turn a handle or a pasted channel URL into a channel_id.
Find videos by topic or by an author's name before fetching details, transcripts or comments.
Public reaction to a video; follow replies_continuation with comment_replies for a thread.
Start here for a video's identity and to see which transcript languages exist before calling video_transcript.
